display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.payer} initializes the LayerZero endpoint with endpoint ID ${data.params.eid} and admin ${data.params.admin}
${accounts.admin}, the endpoint admin, makes ${data.params.admin} the new admin of the LayerZero endpoint
${accounts.admin}, the endpoint admin, sets the token the LayerZero endpoint accepts for LZ token fees
${accounts.admin}, the endpoint admin, registers message library program ${data.params.libProgram} with the LayerZero endpoint as a ${data.params.libType} library
${accounts.admin}, the endpoint admin, sets the first default send library for destination endpoint ID ${data.params.eid} to ${data.params.newLib}
${accounts.admin}, the endpoint admin, sets the default send library for destination endpoint ID ${data.params.eid} to ${data.params.newLib}
${accounts.admin}, the endpoint admin, sets the first default receive library for source endpoint ID ${data.params.eid} to ${data.params.newLib}

${accounts.admin}, the endpoint admin, sets the default receive library for source endpoint ID ${data.params.eid} to ${data.params.newLib}, with a grace period of ${data.params.gracePeriod} slots for the previous one

display.intent: Set a default receive library timeout
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin}, the endpoint admin, sets until which slot previous default receive library ${data.params.lib} stays valid for source endpoint ID ${data.params.eid}: ${data.params.expiry} (0 ends it)
${accounts.admin}, the endpoint admin, withdraws ${data.params.amount} of surplus rent from the LayerZero endpoint to ${accounts.receiver}
${accounts.oapp} registers with the LayerZero endpoint and makes ${data.params.delegate} its delegate, who may change its libraries and configuration
${accounts.delegate} opens the message channel between ${data.params.localOapp} and ${data.params.remoteOapp} on remote endpoint ID ${data.params.remoteEid}
${accounts.delegate} creates the send library setting of ${data.params.sender} for destination endpoint ID ${data.params.eid}
${accounts.signer} sets the send library of ${data.params.sender} for destination endpoint ID ${data.params.eid} to ${data.params.newLib}
${accounts.delegate} creates the receive library setting of ${data.params.receiver} for source endpoint ID ${data.params.eid}

${accounts.signer} sets the receive library of ${data.params.receiver} for source endpoint ID ${data.params.eid} to ${data.params.newLib}, with a grace period of ${data.params.gracePeriod} slots for the previous one

${accounts.signer} sets until which slot ${data.params.receiver} keeps accepting messages from previous receive library ${data.params.lib} for source endpoint ID ${data.params.eid}: ${data.params.expiry} (0 ends it)

docs: The signer among the accounts passed to the message library: with the ULN library, the payer of the new config accounts.
The other accounts passed to the message library. With the ULN library: its settings, the OApp's new send and receive config accounts and the System program.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.delegate} creates the configuration accounts of ${data.params.oapp} for endpoint ID ${data.params.eid} in message library ${accounts.messageLib}

docs: The accounts passed to the message library. With the ULN library: its settings, the OApp's send and receive config accounts, the default send and receive config accounts, its event authority and program.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} sets configuration type ${data.params.configType} of ${data.params.oapp} for endpoint ID ${data.params.eid} in message library ${accounts.messageLib}

docs: The accounts passed to the send library to quote. With the ULN library: its settings, the OApp's and the default send config, then four accounts for the executor and four for each DVN.

display.interpolatedIntent: Quotes the fee for ${data.params.sender} to send a LayerZero message to receiver ${data.params.receiver} on destination endpoint ID ${data.params.dstEid}

docs: The signer among the accounts passed to the send library: with the ULN library, its payer, who pays the native fee to the executor, the DVNs and the treasury.

The other accounts passed to the send library. With the ULN library: its settings, the OApp's and the default send config, the treasury, the System program, its event authority and program, then four accounts for the executor and four for each DVN (the program, its config account, which receives its fee, the price feed program and its config).

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.sender} sends a LayerZero message to receiver ${data.params.receiver} on destination endpoint ID ${data.params.dstEid}, paying a native fee of at most ${data.params.nativeFee} and an LZ token fee of at most ${data.params.lzTokenFee}

${accounts.payer} pays for the account that will hold the verification of message nonce ${data.params.nonce} from sender ${data.params.sender} on source endpoint ID ${data.params.srcEid} to ${data.params.receiver}

Receive library ${accounts.receiveLibrary} records message nonce ${data.params.nonce} from sender ${data.params.sender} on source endpoint ID ${data.params.srcEid} to ${data.params.receiver} as verified, with payload hash ${data.params.payloadHash}

${accounts.signer} skips inbound message nonce ${data.params.nonce} from sender ${data.params.sender} on source endpoint ID ${data.params.srcEid} to ${data.params.receiver}: it will not be verified or delivered

${accounts.signer} burns message nonce ${data.params.nonce} from sender ${data.params.sender} on source endpoint ID ${data.params.srcEid} to ${data.params.receiver}: it can never be verified or delivered

${accounts.signer} nilifies message nonce ${data.params.nonce} from sender ${data.params.sender} on source endpoint ID ${data.params.srcEid} to ${data.params.receiver}: it cannot be delivered until it is verified again

${accounts.signer} takes delivery of verified message nonce ${data.params.nonce} from sender ${data.params.sender} on source endpoint ID ${data.params.srcEid} to ${data.params.receiver}, so it cannot be delivered again
${accounts.from} queues compose message ${data.params.index} of message ${data.params.guid} for ${data.params.to}

display.intent: Take delivery of a compose message
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.to} takes delivery of compose message ${data.params.index} of message ${data.params.guid} from ${data.params.from}, so it cannot be delivered again
${accounts.oapp} makes ${data.params.delegate} its LayerZero delegate, who may change its libraries and configuration

Executor ${accounts.executor} reports that delivering message nonce ${data.params.nonce} from sender ${data.params.sender} on source endpoint ID ${data.params.srcEid} to ${data.params.receiver} failed
Executor ${accounts.executor} reports that delivering compose message ${data.params.index} of message ${data.params.guid} from ${data.params.from} to ${data.params.to} failed
